item.title: Op Sindoor showed India will go to any extent to protect its citizens: Defence min
item.summary: Defence minister Rajnath Singh lauded Operation Sindoor for protecting citizens and sending a strong global message. He compared the operation's courage to the compassion shown at a large blood donation camp. Around one thousand wrestlers and athletes from Maharashtra donated blood at the Delhi Cantt event. Singh emphasized blood donation as a vital contribution, calling it 'Jivandan' and 'Mahadan'.
